scope_declines.name: Sections 29.3.8-29.3.12, Serre duality on X via pi^!, finite and flat comparison propositions and Hom duality
scope_declines.reason: These comparison results transport duality along finite morphisms; the pair instead embeds X into projective space and applies the closed-immersion coinduction adjunction on affine charts.

scope_declines.name: Ch. 3 lattice and Weierstrass theory (lattices, wp, zeta, sigma, elliptic curves)
scope_declines.reason: These results are published on the prerequisite pair elliptic-functions-and-complex-tori; this page cites them and only records the dictionary g2 = 60 G4, g3 = 140 G6 for its own Eisenstein series.

scope_declines.name: §1.1 Theorem 1.6 and Corollaries 1.7–1.8: half-weight theta transformations and shifted theta constants
scope_declines.reason: The assigned product is retained explicitly. These half-weight identities are a possible alternative modularity route; the commissioned weight-integral forms and lambda claims instead have the complete E2/discriminant and Weierstrass routes. No selected item uses the half-weight identities or their square-root branch.

scope_declines.name: Sections 29.2.3-29.2.4 and Exercises 29.2.A-29.2.M, vector-bundle duality for projective space and the local-to-global spectral sequence for Ext
scope_declines.reason: The pair proves derived-space duality through finite twisted locally free resolutions instead of the local-to-global Ext spectral sequence, and no item on the pair states that spectral sequence or its convergence.

scope_declines.name: Lemma 48.27.4 (tag 0FVY), evaluation pairing on a perfect complex
scope_declines.reason: The perfect-complex evaluation pairing is not used as the supplier for the coherent statement on a singular X; the pair builds coherent biduality from the embedding construction without assuming K is perfect over X.

scope_declines.name: Sections 29.3.4-29.3.5, projective schemes as finite covers of projective space and finite projections
scope_declines.reason: The pair constructs the normalized dualizing complex directly from a closed projective embedding and never uses the finite-cover pi^! route, so no item on the pair states those finite-cover results.

scope_declines.name: The divisor-power-sum identities in section 2.2
scope_declines.reason: The owner direction defers Hecke theory and the arithmetic consequences of the sigma identities to the number-theory track; this pair builds only the forms and their first coefficients.

scope_declines.name: Sections 29.4.9-29.4.10 and Exercise 29.4.K, Gorenstein singularities and further duality statements
scope_declines.reason: The Gorenstein-singularity aside and its further exercises lie outside the approved pair scope, which records only the general coherent theorem, its smooth specialization, the curve case and the listed examples.

scope_declines.name: Section 29.1.14, necessity of the Cohen-Macaulay hypothesis
scope_declines.reason: The remark records that the vector-bundle form needs Cohen-Macaulay hypotheses; the pair proves only the positive CM theorem and states no necessity counterexample, so no item carries this remark.

scope_declines.name: Hecke operators, modular L-functions and the arithmetic of tau(n) (§4)
scope_declines.reason: Hecke theory, modular L-functions and complex multiplication are explicitly deferred by the design to number theory and arithmetic geometry and are not part of this pair's commissioned scope.
